decision: Copied unchanged from Cargo/sample_2026-09-27T175344.993.glb. It matches source/design-reference.png (Destroyed cargo unit b5d03922 variant 1): a roughly cubic container with its front panel blown out, a visible blue interior, torn panel edges, and a wide circular snow disc with debris beneath it. The Snowy_cargo_unit and the other Destroyed variant are different designs and were not used. VERDICT AFTER TESTING: this source cannot be optimized into one Roblox mesh at acceptable quality, and the appraisal's own warning was right. The ground disc cuts off at z -0.2754 (trials/probe_slices.py) and the remainder remeshes into one closed manifold shell with zero non-manifold or boundary edges, but nothing will then reduce it to the 7,500 budget: Blender Collapse locks at 16,290 in one pass and converges at 15,798 over repeated passes (trials/probe_iterative.py), and meshoptimizer locks at 15,564 and reports split vertices as the limit. Coarser remeshes do reach 7,500 but fail visual review: 0.006 shreds into disconnected lacework (review/trial-voxel-0p006.png) and 0.013 melts into a blobby box with random wall holes (review/trial-voxel-0p013.png). So this GLB is reference and measurement only. Delivering this design needs either a two-mesh split of the faithful ~15,800-triangle wreck or a clean rebuild; that choice is open and is recorded in HANDOFF.md.
